# ankra_cluster_labels (Resource)

The free-form labels on a cluster, which dynamic cluster groups select on. The resource owns the cluster's whole label set: a label that is not in `labels`, including one added in the portal, is removed on the next apply. Destroying the resource removes every label it manages. The cluster's environment is not a label; it is set on the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cluster_labels" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
  labels = {
    team   = "payments"
    region = "eu-north"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels by key, at most 32. Keys are 1-63 lower-case letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-` or `/`; values are 1-63 letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`; both start and end with a letter or digit. The key `environment` is reserved.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by cluster id. The resource then owns every label on the cluster.
terraform import ankra_cluster_labels.prod 0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666
```
